# WO-603: Report claims sites were "asked" when nothing was sent
Status: queued (in-house)
Vendor: claude
Agent: wizard-packager (Nina Alvarez)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Kind: wizard
Severity: HIGH
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner real-data test, stage 1 (search only), qa-security 2026-11-11. Private results are kept outside the repo; this WO is PII-free by rule.

## Goal
After only `scan` and `run --dry-run` on the owner test folder (0 requests sent, 366 DRAFT letters, 423 brokers NEEDS_HUMAN), `freemyid report --format html` said "Free My ID has asked 423 people-search sites to delete this person's details". Nothing was asked. `wizard/report.py:23` puts `ListingState.NEEDS_HUMAN` in `_ASKED`, and line 65 prints that count as "asked". A user (or a relative helping them) would believe removals are under way, and the report is the document people keep. The same sentence calls every broker a "people-search site" although most of the 424 are marketing/B2B data brokers.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. "Asked" counts only brokers with a real submission (`BrokerStatus.last_submitted_at` set, or a non-dry-run request with status SENT/SUBMITTED). NEEDS_HUMAN without a submission is counted under "need you to do one step", never under "asked".
2. A dry-run request (`Request.dry_run=True`) never counts as asked anywhere in the report.
3. When nothing has been sent yet, the opening line says so plainly ("Nothing has been sent yet. N sites need one step from you.").
4. Wording says "data broker sites" (or "sites that sell personal details"), not "people-search sites", unless every counted broker is in the people-search category.
5. Tests with fake profiles: (a) dry-run only -> asked 0; (b) one real SUBMITTED + one NEEDS_HUMAN -> asked 1, need-you 1; (c) report text has no profile PII beyond the label.
